Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking a Python Automation Developer to join the Vodafone Group Software Automation team and contribute to Vodafone's digital transformation programme.
You will develop Python-based solutions that automate operational processes, working across the full delivery lifecycle from solution planning and design through development, testing and deployment. You will collaborate with data engineers, software developers and system specialists, while taking ownership of your solutions and contributing technical expertise and best practices to the wider team.
This role is suited to someone with 1–5 years of Python experience , knowledge of databases and Linux, familiarity with CI/CD and Git, and an understanding of systems integration technologies such as REST and HTTP/S.
 What You’ll Do
Develop Python modules, APIs, and microservices that make internal libraries accessible 
Shape and maintain the automation development environment, including Python libraries, virtual machines, and databases 
Develop software collaboratively using Agile ways of working 
Support customers during solution design to create flexible, maintainable solutions 
Participate in the planning and design of solutions for business use cases 
Share coding standards, development practices and technical knowledge across the team 
Keep up to date with relevant current and emerging technologies 
Participate in internal and external workshops to expand your knowledge 
Apply continuous development, integration, testing, and deployment practices 
Implement projects using technologies suited to their technical and business objectives 
Follow agreed coding standards and maintain clear code documentation 
Manage assigned projects proactively and take ownership of resolving issues 
Create and maintain technical design documentation 
Provide accurate and regular progress reporting for assigned programmes 
 Who You Are
A degree in Computer Science or a comparable qualification 
1–5 years of experience with Python 
Fluent in English 
Strong programming knowledge and an interest in learning new technologies 
Problem-solving and solution-focused thinking 
Analytical capability and attention to detail 
Awareness of CI/CD tools and automated build processes 
Experience with Git or comparable version control systems 
Knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases 
Knowledge of Linux, scripting, command-line tools, and operating system administration 
Knowledge of systems integration and communication technologies, including REST, HTTP/S, SNMP, SSH, and SOAP 
The ability to work collaboratively, share technical knowledge, and contribute to common development standards 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working: 2 days from office per week (8 per month)
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the following options: meal tickets / private pension / vacation vouchers / cultural vouchers - within the budget 
Special discounts for gyms and retailers
Annual Company Bonus
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills 
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun, and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
Python-based automation, API, and microservice development 
CI/CD and continuous development, integration, testing, and deployment practices 
Software architecture and technical solution design 
Linux-based development and operational environments 
Database technologies and systems integration 
Agile software delivery and end-to-end product ownership 
Technical documentation, coding standards, and collaborative knowledge sharing

 Join Us
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
